_note: FAD (fish aggregating device) buoys for the MaKs Cast viewer overlay. This file is not written by the daily map job. Positions are published deployment/anchor coordinates; buoys can swing around the anchor (Okaloosa lists ~500 ft). Do not use for navigation. Do not tie up to a FAD.

fads.name: Okaloosa FAD 1
fads.source: Okaloosa County Coastal Resource Team table, published by Get The Coast, 7 Oct 2022, after FADs 5 and 6 were redeployed (https://getthecoast.com/two-fish-aggregating-device-fad-buoys-redeployed-off-coast-of-destin-fort-walton-beach/). Network also described by Destin-Fort Walton Beach (https://www.destinfwb.com/blog/what-is-a-fish-aggregating-device/).
fads.notes: Position may vary by ~500 ft around the anchor.

fads.label: FAD 9
fads.name: Okaloosa FAD 9
fads.source: Okaloosa County proposed/approved coordinates published by Get The Coast, 1 Jul 2025 (https://getthecoast.com/okaloosa-county-expands-fishing-network-approves-8-shallow-water-fad-buoys/), citing Taylor Engineering Figure 1 (Jan 2025). All eight shallow buoys were deployed 28 Dec 2025 (https://getthecoast.com/okaloosa-county-deploys-8-new-shallow-water-fish-aggregating-buoys-in-the-gulf/).
fads.notes: Last published table. Two of the eight shallow sites were shifted ~0.5 nm after a Nov 2024 bottom survey; the county did not name the pair or publish revised numbers. Depths for the shallow network are 206–297 ft.

fads.label: LA 148
fads.name: LDWF FAD · MC-148
fads.source: Louisiana Department of Wildlife and Fisheries news release, 13 Jul 2023: 'The buoy is at coordinates Latitude 28° 47.646' Longitude 89° 10.527'' (https://www.wlf.louisiana.gov/news/ldwf-deploys-fad-buoy-in-gulf-of-mexico). Mississippi Canyon 148 Reef, about 30 nm SSE of Venice.
fads.notes: About 122 nm from Perdido Pass. A 2026 LDWF maintenance bid (RFx 3000026662, Attachment C) lists a nearby 'center of buoy system' at 28° 47' 39.328" N, 89° 10' 28.489" W (~300 ft from the 2023 published point).
